title: Lesson 1 Quiz: Reading Price Charts and Market Data

questions.text: How is market capitalisation calculated for a cryptocurrency?
options: Current price multiplied by total supply (including locked tokens)
Current price multiplied by circulating supply
Average price over 24 hours multiplied by circulating supply
Current price divided by circulating supply
questions.explanation: Market capitalisation equals current price multiplied by circulating supply.

questions.text: True or false: A price rise on tiny volume shows strong momentum.
questions.explanation: False. A price rise on high volume shows strong interest and real momentum; a price rise on tiny volume is weak and can easily reverse.
